info.description: REST API for the Pacto service contract dashboard. Serves the operational graph of a service fleet, plus the contract-view endpoints the offline static export answers.
info.title: Pacto Dashboard API

get.description: Reports which optional capabilities (fleet, impact) the running host serves.

The newest change that moved a Stage to a digest (by default the one it runs): who asked, for whom, who approved and what every check said, read from its signed record when there is one. No change with a partial completeness means unknown, never nobody.

get.description: Service by environment: the digest and version each Stage runs and whether it is verified, failed, frozen, held or on auto-hold.

What happened on each Stage: read from its signed records when the recorder runs (source records), plus the operations not recorded yet, otherwise from the operations still in the cluster (source status, always partial). Each history carries its own completeness, problems and what could not be read.

post.description: Promote, roll back (with undoes) or unfreeze, as the caller. Pass the plan's intent digest: anything that moved since fails with PlanStale and the fresh plan. Override stays in the CLI, for break-glass.

get.description: The explained operation (summary, verdicts with how to re-run each), the operation itself (plan, approvals, times) and the actions the caller may take.

post.description: Approve, reject or accept an unknown, as the signed-in person, with a login made fresh for it. Only the teams the question names may decide. Never served in local mode or to agents.
What the promoter would do: verdicts, whether a person must decide, who and the question.

get.description: Per service the caller can see Stages of: the versions its Stages know, whether Flux verified their signature and which Stages run or verified each.

Recent publishes Pacto refused, newest first, with the check that refused each and the version bump the change needs. recorded false means this cluster keeps no record of refused publishes, so an empty list proves nothing.

A plan nobody has proposed: a rollback bound to the change when the Stage still runs it, a promote back to the version it replaced when something changed since, or nothing. It never acts; propose the plan to carry it out.

Returns the immutable fleet snapshot: logical services, contract revisions, operational targets, relationships and source states, with an as-of time and completeness. This is a whole-fleet BULK EXPORT for machine consumers and is deliberately unpaged: its size grows with the fleet. A consumer that wants a page, a filter or a bounded answer should use the product endpoints under /api/fleet/product, every one of which is paged and reports what it left out.
